synthetic.scope: Filesystem observation and durable source/availability/job writes; decoder work excluded
synthetic.baselineCheck: Watcher enqueue plus discovery and cleanup, including final job/run settlement

lab.data: A consistent SQLite backup of the live database; root paths remapped from container mount paths to the same host media
lab.isolation: Production database was only read. Migration, compaction, server startup and benchmark writes used the copy.
lab.contention: Shared HDD was busy. Baseline isolated checks took 50-255 seconds; live prior-24h discovery jobs averaged 3.88 seconds. These are separate measurements, not interchangeable timings.
lab.afterRunsPerDay: Zero new runs over repeated unchanged checks; zero per day is a projection for an unchanged library, not a live 24-hour deployment measurement.
lab.migration: Final migration uses an explicitly indexed temporary summary table. Three earlier attempts were interrupted: aggregation variants exposed cold HDD reads and a Bun SQLite plan that repeatedly scanned materialized summaries. A sequential file read warmed the copy during the earlier attempt; caches remain uncontrolled for the final run. Final statement-prepare timestamps are logged without changing SQLite execution settings.
lab.startup: Elapsed time reported by server_listening, using the database copy and the real server process
lab.cache: Before/after measurements use the same isolated copy before and after migration/compaction. OS cache and competing HDD activity are uncontrolled; local synthetic results are the cleaner comparison.
